assumptions.scenario: agency firm; every order is routed to one exchange; executions are reported by the exchange
assumptions.route latency: exchange acknowledgement arrives 0.2 to 2.0 ms after the route, uniform
assumptions.timing window: a route or cancel timestamp is accepted if the acknowledgement follows it by -1.0 to +3.5 ms
assumptions.account holder type: taken from the account master by account class
assumptions.one error per order: each seeded error is on a different order

dup_order_key.description: orderID reused for a second order on the same day

wrong_routed_id.description: routedOrderID does not match what was sent

wrong_session.description: session does not match what was sent

out_of_sequence.description: cancel timestamp earlier than the new order

fdid_unknown.description: firmDesignatedID not in the firm's reference data

fdid_pending.description: firmDesignatedID still PENDING in the account master

wrong_side.description: side reported as the opposite side

wrong_qty.description: quantity reported is not the order quantity

wrong_price.description: price reported is off by a factor of 100

clock_drift.description: order host clock ahead by a fixed offset

wrong_aht_report.description: accountHolderType differs from the account master

wrong_aht_master.description: accountHolderType wrong in the account master
